02 — THE CLUB

More than
a brand.
A club.

INDULGE PLAYAS CLUB is a Manila-born clothing brand, running since 2023 — founded by a small circle of friends who wanted pieces they couldn't find in local stores: clean designs, heavyweight fabric, and fits that hold up from the morning commute to the late-night gig. The OG logo tee with its silver stitch marked the beginning, and that same club mark still leads every drop.

The brand grew out of the local scene — the music, the courts, the streets — and it still moves that way. Every drop gets announced on our Facebook page first, reserved by message, then released in numbered batches: meetup around the metro or shipped anywhere in the country, always free. That model keeps the circle small and the quality up — pieces we actually wear, tested where we actually live.

Every piece we release carries the club motto — strictly for playas only. It sets the standard for who we build for: people who play hard, work harder, and look right doing both. The circle stays small on purpose, and every new member earns the spot.

01 Small Batches Numbered runs, announced on socials. When a piece sells out, it stays sold out.
02 Local First Designed and printed in the Philippines — by us, for the streets here.
03 Heavy Fabric Thick cotton and sturdy builds that survive the wash, the heat and the grind.
04 Free Shipping Every order ships free anywhere in the Philippines — no minimum spend, no fine print.

03 — FROM THE VAULT

Where it
started.

Straight outta Sampaloc, Manila — this is where the club began. Before the numbered batches and the free nationwide shipping, there was the circle, one heavy tee and graphics loud enough to speak for themselves. We keep the early work archived here — same energy, cleaner lines, same club.

THE FIRST GRAPHICS WERE LOUD ON PURPOSE — HANDSTYLES, CAMO AND THE MARK EVERYWHERE. THAT'S THE ARC FROM THEN TO NOW.

MEASURED LAYING FLAT — GIVE OR TAKE HALF AN INCH, COTTON IS ALIVE.

KEEPING HEAVY COTTON HEAVY

  • Wash cold, inside out, with like colors.
  • Hang dry — the dryer is the enemy of heavy cotton.
  • No bleach, no ironing straight on prints or stitch.
  • Fold, don't hang, the knits.

01

OVERSIZED PIECES

Hoodies and boxy tees are cut that way on purpose — take your usual size for the intended drape, size down for a cleaner fit.

02

REGULAR PIECES

Outerwear and cargos run true to size with a little room through the chest and thigh.

03

Message the club with the piece name — we'll send the exact laid-flat measurements of that piece before you commit.

06 — FAQ

Asked all
the time.

When does the first drop land?

The first collection is in the final run right now. The date, the pieces and the prices get announced on our Facebook page first — follow the club and turn on notifications so you're early, not late.

How do I reserve a piece?

Message the page on Facebook or email the club with the piece name and size. First message, first serve — when a batch is claimed, it's claimed.

How do I pay?

GCash for shipped orders, cash on meetup. The total gets confirmed in the thread before you send anything — no hidden fees, ever.

Is shipping really free?

Every order ships free anywhere in the Philippines — no minimum spend, no small-print exclusions. Metro Manila usually takes a few days; provinces a little longer depending on the courier.

What if my size sells out?

Pieces run in numbered batches — a sold-out size stays sold out until a restock. Restock news posts on Facebook first, and you can message us to be noted for the next run of your size.

How should I wash my pieces?

Cold water, inside out, hang dry. Heavy cotton rewards gentle handling — do that and the prints and stitch stay crisp for years.

Do you do collabs or customs?

Open to the right ones. Send your proposal to the club email with references and quantities — serious inquiries get answers.

How do I know a piece is legit?

Everything sells through this page and our Facebook page only — no third-party sellers, no reseller drops. If it didn't come from the club, it's not the club.
